track.title: EmpireData and SpaceData logical schema archaeology
track.array_policy: Arrays use fixed authored order; no unordered-set output, random values, timestamps, or wall-clock fields.

included: planets, colonies, civilizations, tribes, stars, political ownership, and identifiers
fleets, ships, vehicles, tools, inventory, cargo, commodities, and trade
relationships, communications, missions, events, runtime objects, lifecycle, and persistence
OpenSpore source correspondence and missing semantics
excluded: asset bytes, models, textures, sounds, scripts, and proprietary source copying
Ghidra writes, renames, type changes, saves, and historical artifact rewrites

runtime_evidence.reason: The committed runtime campaign is negative for reaching Cell Stage under the tested Wine/input conditions; no empire, space, diplomacy, or economy transition is observed.

policy.SDK: Imported names, sizes, offsets, field names, enums, and interface declarations are static evidence, not proof of undocumented behavior.
policy.Ghidra: Bodies establish bounded call shape, memory access, allocation, dispatch, and transitions; unnamed symbols and decompiler types remain uncertain.
policy.OpenSpore: Source establishes current OpenSpore behavior only; resemblance is not original semantic proof.
policy.runtime: No empire or space gameplay observation is available; gameplay behavior is not promoted to OBSERVED or VERIFIED.

source_precedence: pinned binary identity and committed runtime artifacts
pinned Ghidra exports, SDK XML, structure fields, vtable candidates, and xrefs
existing research dossiers and campaign documents
evidence_base.coverage: Pinned snapshot has 58,757 functions and 172/2,149 gameplay functions with decompilation coverage. Targeted read-only bodies do not rewrite that ledger.
evidence_base.historical_rule: The committed decomp-gap unavailable state remains authoritative for accounting even where a read-only Ghidra body was available.

lifecycle.create: Create/load empire, assign political ID, species profile, home world, and identity color.
lifecycle.query: Resolve active context and player empire through shared accessors and manager lookup.
lifecycle.mutate: Update identity, ownership, relations, money, culture, and asset references.
lifecycle.serialize: ISimulatorSerializable prefix exists; exact property set is unresolved.
lifecycle.destroy: Refcount release through imported vtable/prefix conventions; exact teardown is unresolved.

schemas.purpose: Represent active space mode, galaxy records, active context, colonies, and runtime composition.
relations: cSimulatorSpaceGame -> inventory, UFO, mission, NPC, and uplift state

lifecycle.create: Generate/load star records, generate planets, attach civ/tribe/commodity records, and create runtime objects.
lifecycle.query: Resolve star grid, find stars/empire, read active planet/star, and read planet records.
lifecycle.mutate: Regenerate empty systems, set ownership, assign home world, update colonies, and update UFO state.
lifecycle.serialize: Star/planet serialization plus temporary and saved record databases.
lifecycle.destroy: Refcount release and manager reset; exact teardown is unresolved.

schemas.purpose: Represent colony-capable planet state with civ/tribe subrecords and player membership.
schemas.lifecycle: Static data supports planet lookup and colony membership; colonization, uplift, and full civ transition bodies are incomplete.

schemas.purpose: Represent ship/vehicle runtime objects without claiming a single SDK Fleet record.
schemas.lifecycle: Create/load spacecraft, update movement/energy/combat, acquire targets, and release objects. Fleet aggregate and full ownership protocol are unresolved.

schemas.purpose: Represent item counts, costs, cargo, tools, unlocks, and active selections.
schemas.lifecycle: Create/load items, apply properties, mutate counts, select active tool/cargo, use/drop/obtain items, and release them. Insertion, removal, capacity, and payout bodies are incomplete.

schemas.purpose: Represent spices, rare discovery, NPC stores, commodity ownership, trading objects, prices, and routes.
schemas.lifecycle: Generate/assign commodity state, query rare/spice availability, create stores, acquire objects, mutate ownership/count/cost, and persist routes. Formulas are unresolved.

schemas.purpose: Represent relationship value, war/alliance flags, event map, and decay state.
schemas.lifecycle: Create/find relation, query war/alliance, apply deltas, declare war/peace/alliance, break alliance, and decay. Message payloads remain unresolved.

schemas.purpose: Represent mission state, owner/target worlds, rewards, costs, progress, communication, and tracking.
schemas.lifecycle: Generate, query, choose, accept/reject, activate, complete, fail, abort, and destroy. Reward and event ordering are incomplete.

schemas.purpose: Represent communication/space event payloads, positions, queueing, dispatch, and release.
schemas.lifecycle: Create, initialize, append, show/dispatch, and release. Numeric IDs and cross-stage ordering are unresolved.

relationships.detail: Named getters and high-fan-in accessors exist; exact owner/type of every packed accessor is unresolved.
The cached cEmpire.mPoliticalID at +0x84 is compared with the stored ID; mismatch triggers lookup, pointer replacement, and old-object release.
War is flag bit 0; alliance is flag bit 1.

functions.contract: Clear war bit 0 when a relation exists, update empire/message state, and execute the observed player path.

functions.contract: Set war bit 0, clear alliance bit 1, update empire/civ state, emit the observed player path, and apply relationship deltas.

functions.name: DeclareAlliance
functions.contract: Follow peace, set alliance bit 1, update empire state, and emit the observed player relationship path.

gaps.statement: No committed runtime trace reaches empire or space gameplay.
gaps.impact: Behavior beyond static layouts and bounded call shape is non-observed.
gaps.next_action: Require a separately approved future space/empire trace before promotion.

gaps.statement: High-fan-in packed manager accessors lack fully named owner/type and setter/reset boundaries.
gaps.impact: Subsystem roots cannot be safely merged by adjacency alone.
gaps.next_action: Characterize every accessor, global, setter, and reset path.

gaps.statement: Orbit, scores, species, commodities, rare systems, and colonization formulas are incomplete.
gaps.impact: PlanetData can be schema-shaped but not behavior-compatible.
gaps.next_action: Recover deterministic inputs, random calls, property IDs, and side effects.

gaps.statement: cCivilization, cCivData, cTribeData, colony membership, colonization, and uplift are only partially linked.
gaps.impact: Complete civ ownership and progression cannot be claimed.
gaps.next_action: Trace civ/tribe record producers, consumers, and persistence.

gaps.statement: Item insertion/removal, cargo capacity, price/payment, rare discovery, NPC selection, and route mutation are incomplete.
gaps.next_action: Trace inventory mutators, trading callers, commodity consumers, and trade-route accessors.

gaps.statement: War/alliance flags are known, but event IDs, decay, side effects, and non-player payloads are not.
gaps.next_action: Read relationship message producers and event-map consumers.

gaps.statement: Mission callbacks and states are named, but creation, accept/reject, completion/failure, reward, and unlock ordering is incomplete.
gaps.impact: Mission reward/event ordering cannot be reproduced.
gaps.next_action: Trace cMission callbacks, manager transition callers, money, and inventory mutations.

gaps.statement: Ship/vehicle structs exist, but fleet aggregation, ownership, creation/destruction, and runtime transitions are incomplete.
gaps.impact: FleetData is bounded composition, not a verified fleet simulation.
gaps.next_action: Trace space-session, UFO, vehicle, and NPC-UFO lifecycles.

gaps.statement: PropertyList behavior is known, but hashed property IDs are not semantically named.
gaps.impact: Opaque values can be preserved, not independently recreated.
gaps.next_action: Recover the property dictionary through adjacent call sites and committed metadata.

gaps.statement: The 27-field and 24-field records are unnamed and their meanings are inferred from builder writes.
gaps.impact: Do not expose them as verified public schemas.
gaps.next_action: Name record consumers and correlate fields with message/action dispatch.

gaps.statement: Original cResourceManager load, cache, and precedence behavior is not reconstructed by the OpenSpore provider seam.
gaps.impact: ResourceKey references are not end-to-end resolved in original order.
gaps.next_action: Keep the provider seam isolated and recover only through committed static evidence.

contradictions.statement: The committed decomp-gap ledger marks targeted bodies unavailable while read-only Ghidra returns bodies.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve unavailable historical accounting; use bodies only as bounded mechanics evidence and do not add coverage.

contradictions.statement: Read-only live Ghidra reports 59,245 functions while the pinned snapshot reports 58,757.
contradictions.resolution: Use pinned counts/triage; record live Ghidra only as a read-only cross-check and do not rewrite history.

contradictions.statement: Pinned exports associate some star-manager addresses with named routines, while live bodies recover generic vector/grid operations.
contradictions.resolution: Retain address and mechanics, downgrade exact SDK name until entry/ABI reconciliation.

contradictions.statement: Triage associates 0x00aeb720 with HandleSpaceCommAction while the body matches create-and-dispatch.
contradictions.resolution: Keep address/mechanics; do not promote HandleSpaceCommAction.

contradictions.statement: The SDK vtable label for cSpaceInventoryItem slot +0x4c is not reconciled with the candidate target recovered from the item initialization path.
contradictions.resolution: Preserve SDK label and candidate target separately; do not claim exact runtime meaning.

contradictions.statement: Vtable-prefix relations look like inheritance, but the binary has no MSVC RTTI and the vtable pass labels are limited.
contradictions.resolution: Model interfaces/ownership as evidence-bounded relations; do not publish definitive inheritance.

contradictions.statement: cPlanetRecord::Create and RecordToPlanet have strong SDK names but thin live bodies; full record-to-runtime cPlanet path is not isolated.
contradictions.resolution: Claim record schema and bounded conversion call, not complete runtime construction.
